props.placeholder: Why is this super-lot being opened?

config.script:
v = self.view
	d = dict(BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(v.custom.draft))
	t = (d.get("anchorText") or "").strip()
	lot = BlueRidge.Lots.Lot.getByName(t) if t else None
	if lot and lot.get("Id"):
		d["anchorLotId"] = lot.get("Id")
		d["anchorLotName"] = lot.get("LotName") or t
		d["anchorInfo"] = "Found %s (%s). Part filled in below; From left blank means from when this LOT was made." % (
			lot.get("LotName") or t, lot.get("ItemPartNumber") or "")
		d["itemId"] = lot.get("ItemId")
		d["fromAtEastern"] = None
		d["includeDescendants"] = True
	else:
		d["anchorLotId"] = None
		d["anchorLotName"] = ""
		d["anchorInfo"] = "No LOT named %s." % t if t else ""
	v.custom.draft = d	  # ONE write: no half-filled draft is ever bound

props.text: Include everything made from the suspect LOT
Follows the genealogy: sub-assemblies and finished containers it went into, wherever they are.
New LOTs of this part made on this line are tagged CRT and added until you press End window. Needs a part.

config.script:
v = self.view
	d = BlueRidge.Common.Util.extractQualifiedValues(v.custom.draft)
	if not (d.get("reason") or "").strip():
		BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Reason needed", "Say why this super-lot is being opened.", "warning")
		return
	rows = BlueRidge.Quality.ControlledRun.preview(d)
	v.custom.rowsJson = BlueRidge.Quality.ControlledRun.previewEncode(rows)
	v.custom.step = 2

props.text: Nothing matched. Go back and widen the selection, or keep adding new production.
Oldest first. Rows that cannot be added stay on the list so you can see what the window missed.

config.expression: 'This will put ' + toStr({view.custom.totals.lots}) + ' LOTs and ' + toStr({view.custom.totals.containers}) + ' containers (' + numberFormat({view.custom.totals.pieces}, '#,##0') + ' pieces) on CRT and group them as one super-lot. Tagged material cannot be used or shipped until it is cleared.'

props.text: New production of this part will keep being tagged and added until the window is ended.

config.script:
v = self.view
	if v.custom.busy:
		return
	v.custom.busy = True
	try:
		tid = v.params.terminalLocationId
		el = BlueRidge.Location.AppUser.elevate(v.custom.adAccount, v.custom.password, "ControlledRun", tid)
		v.custom.password = ""   # credentials are not retained
		if not el or not el.get("success"):
			BlueRidge.Common.Notify.toast("Not authorised", (el or {}).get("message") or "Authentication failed.", "error")
			return
		CR = BlueRidge.Quality.ControlledRun
		res = CR.open(v.custom.draft, CR.previewTicked(v.custom.rowsJson), el.get("appUserId"), tid)
		BlueRidge.Common.Ui.notifyResult(res, "Super-lot")
		if res and res.get("Status"):
			system.perspective.sendMessage("controlledRunSelect", payload={"runId": res.get("NewId")}, scope="page")
			system.perspective.closePopup(v.params.popupId)
	finally:
		v.custom.busy = False
